title: The Slime Cellar
author: Example Mod
description: A short test adventure that uses the mod's own monsters.

text: The innkeeper of Emberpine begs {name} to clear out his cellar.
Something green has been oozing out from under the door all week.

check.label: lockpicking
check.fail_text: The lock jams and the noise wakes everything up!

text: The door swings open. Two slimes bubble up, with a wisp floating behind them!
You slip in through the coal chute. A slime and a wisp spot you right away!
The cellar is quiet at last. The innkeeper pays you in free soup.
Behind the barrels, a stone staircase leads even deeper.

choices.text: That's enough soup-related heroics for one day

text: A medusa coils on the bottom step. Don't meet her gaze for long!
A hungry leech buzzes at her side.
deep_fight.fight_prompt: Press Enter to face the medusa
